{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Count how many rows have invalid revenue (NaN)
dropped_rows = sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum()
print(f'Dropped {dropped_rows} rows due to invalid revenue values.')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Count completed orders after dropping invalid revenue
completed_count = len(completed_orders)
print(f'Number of completed orders: {completed_count}')

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}')"}
